sentences.text: S2 attended the meeting with S1.
S2 stated she left Poppy with her mum.
S2 stated Poppy is fourteen months old and is walking everywhere.
S2 stated Alfie attends Little Stars nursery on Bank Street, Monday to Friday, mornings.
S2 stated Alfie is a fussy eater who only has pasta and fish fingers.
S2 stated Alfie sleeps from seven till seven.
S1 stated the meeting is regarding a letter before proceedings from the council and a meeting scheduled for the first of December.
S1 stated the letter concerns a bruise on Alfie's arm seen by the nursery on the ninth of November and police being called to the house in October.
S1 stated S2 told the social worker, Ms Okoye, that Alfie fell off the sofa.
S2 stated that Jordan slapped Alfie.
S2 stated Jordan slapped Alfie across the face because he wouldn't eat his tea.
S2 stated the incident on the 8th of November occurred at about five o'clock.
S2 stated Jordan grabbed Alfie by the arm, really hard, and pulled him off the chair, causing the bruise.
S2 stated she was at the sink when she saw the bruise.
S2 stated Jordan told her to say Alfie fell off the sofa when Ms Okoye came.
S2 stated that in October, they were arguing and shouting, and a neighbour rang the police; the police just talked to them.
S2 stated Jordan is at his mum's this week and will be back on Saturday.
S2 stated Jordan said he would take the kids and Poppy if she left him.
S2 stated Jordan has never taken the children anywhere without her agreement.
S2 stated she receives Universal Credit and child benefit for both children.
S2 stated Jordan has the bank card for the joint account.
S2 stated she wants her kids to stay with her.
S1 stated Jordan cannot take the children without going to court.
S1 stated S2 can apply for a non-molestation order to stop Jordan coming to the house.
S1 stated S2 would likely get legal aid for the non-molestation order.
S1 advised S2 to tell Ms Okoye what really happened before the meeting.
S1 stated telling the truth and keeping Jordan away protects Alfie and S2 in the process.
S1 stated S2 is in a stronger position if she tells the truth and acts to keep her child safe compared to backing her partner's story.
S1 stated he would only write to Ms Okoye if S2 gave him permission.
S2 gave permission for S1 to write to Ms Okoye with the account provided.
